name: PunisherFinTheme
overview: Selectable, accent-aware designs for Jellyfin Web.
description: Offers complete PunisherFin and Cinema Deck designs for cards, episodes, details, previews, and players while preserving Jellyfin's native behavior.

versions.changelog: Fixes the design gallery on dynamically loaded Jellyfin settings pages. The preview styles are now delivered as a dedicated embedded plugin resource and injected into Jellyfin's actual document with an explicit cache-safe version, so the selectable homepage miniatures and live preview can no longer collapse into unstyled inline text.

Rebuilds design selection as a reliable visual gallery with full homepage miniatures and a larger live preview that follows the global accent color. The optional Cinematic preset is replaced by the distinctly styled Cinema Deck experience: compact landscape media cards, editorial shelf panels, image-focused information surfaces, restrained rectangular controls, and a timeline-style episode list. The original PunisherFin design remains visually unchanged and continues to be the default.
